d:
Purv rajyasbha sansad aur desh ki agrani suraksha seva kanpni esaaaeees (SIS) ke sansthapak svargiy aar.ke. sinha ke shok karyakram evan shraddhanjli sabha men rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke pramukh lalu prasad yadav aur rajad sansad misa bharti shamil hue. unke sath parti ke kaee any varishth neta bhi maujud rahe, jinhonne divangat neta ko bhavbhini shraddhanjli arpit ki.
Daliy simaon se oopar uthkar arpit kie shraddhasuman
